title: Search systematically when target object location is unknown
description: Use when the target object is not immediately visible and its location must be discovered.
content: When searching for an object, systematically inspect likely storage locations such as cabinets, drawers, shelves, and countertops. Open closed containers to check their contents, and continue until the target object is found.

source.task_query: Your task is to: cool some bread and put it in diningtable.

title: Transport objects one at a time to the destination
description: Use when moving multiple objects to the same target location.
content: Pick up one object, carry it to the destination, and place it there before returning for the next object. Repeating this cycle for each required item ensures all objects are successfully moved without losing track of what has been placed.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put two watch in shelf.

title: Clean objects at a sink basin before disposal
description: Use this when the task involves both cleaning and discarding an object.
content: After picking up the object, navigate to a sink basin and use the "clean [object] with [sink]" action to complete the cleaning step. Only after cleaning is confirmed should you proceed to the disposal location.

source.task_query: Your task is to: clean some egg and put it in garbagecan.

title: Place items into a closed microwave
description: Use this when a task requires putting an item into a microwave that is initially closed.
content: Before moving an item into a microwave, open the microwave first. Once the microwave is open, use the move action to place the item inside; the microwave may already contain other objects, which does not prevent adding the new item.
